title: Dependency vulnerability scan — FRIDAY Universe fleet
database: OSV (api.osv.dev), the upstream pip-audit queries via PyPI
target: CPython 3.11 (latest patch), Linux x86_64 — matches repo base image python:3.11-slim
method: Per-agent manifests (requirements*.txt + pyproject.toml) resolved against PyPI as a fresh install (max satisfying version, transitive requires_dist closure with marker evaluation, pip yanked-file semantics, bounded backtracking), then every resolved (name, version) queried against OSV; GHSA/PYSEC twins deduplicated by CVE.
